faqs.q: Where is the Modular Subsea Support Buoy used?
faqs.a: The Modular Subsea Support Buoy is part of the mooring buoy range for marking, supporting or holding mooring lines, with size set by the line load and water depth.

faqs.q: Can I buy the Modular Subsea Support Buoy ex-stock from Dubai?

faqs.q: What is the Subsea Support Buoy used for?
faqs.a: The Subsea Support Buoy is a subsea support buoy, rated by depth. The listing covers 35 sizes, 680 kg module — surface to 3,400 kg module — 2000 m depth rating. See the [mooring buoys](/c/mooring-buoys) shelf for the full range.

faqs.q: Which sizes of Subsea Support Buoy are available?
faqs.a: The Subsea Support Buoy is listed in 35 sizes, 680 kg module — surface to 3,400 kg module — 2000 m depth rating. Every size has its own Indus part number, for example IH-MR-BY-SSB-680KG-S (680 kg module — surface) or IH-MR-BY-SSB-3400KG-2000 (3,400 kg module — 2000 m depth rating). The letters in the size table match the dimension drawing.

faqs.q: How do I choose the right size of Subsea Support Buoy?
faqs.a: Net buoyancy must carry the weight in water of the chain and fittings the Subsea Support Buoy supports, with reserve. Send the line make-up and water depth and we propose a size. State the net buoyancy, the depth rating and the chain or connection size.

faqs.q: What buoyancy does the Subsea Support Buoy provide?
faqs.a: The Subsea Support Buoy lists a buoyancy of 380 kg to 3,400 kg across its sizes and depth ratings. At a 2000 m depth rating the largest module lists 1,920 kg of buoyancy and a weight of 2,400 kg. Net buoyancy is what is left after the buoy's own weight, so size it on the weight in water of the line it carries.

faqs.q: What do I send to get a quote for the Subsea Support Buoy?
faqs.a: Quote the Indus part number from the size table, for example IH-MR-BY-SSB-680KG-S (680 kg module — surface) or IH-MR-BY-SSB-3400KG-2000 (3,400 kg module — 2000 m depth rating), with the quantity. State the net buoyancy, the depth rating and the chain or connection size. If you only know the load, send it with the line make-up and we match the part number.

faqs.q: How does the Subsea Support Buoy compare with the Modular Subsea Support Buoy?
faqs.a: The Subsea Support Buoy is a subsea support buoy, rated by depth, while the Modular Subsea Support Buoy is a modular subsea support buoy, rated by depth. Choose between them on the design load, the seabed or connection and the certificate you need. The Subsea Support Buoy is listed in 35 sizes. See the [Modular Subsea Support Buoy](/p/modular-subsea-support-buoy) for its own details.

faqs.q: Are the dimensions in the Subsea Support Buoy size table exact?
faqs.a: The letters in the Subsea Support Buoy size table match the dimension drawing shown with the product. Dimensions are typical and can vary slightly between production runs. The drawing sent with the quotation is final.

faqs.q: What certificate comes with the Subsea Support Buoy?
faqs.a: We quote the Subsea Support Buoy with the drawing and certificate you need, so state the certificate required on the enquiry. The listing does not name a standard or class-society approval for this item, so any approval you need is confirmed with the quotation. Do not assume a class-society approval unless it is in writing.

faqs.q: What does the Subsea Support Buoy connect to?
faqs.a: The Subsea Support Buoy attaches to the mooring or support line through its connection fittings, which must be rated for the line load and sized to the chain.
